Name: Berry Snacks by Wickedy
Author: WickedyWoah
Description:
[b][size=4]Hey, Hi, Howdy, and Hello Friends![/size][/b]

Picture this. It’s your first spring and you are completely out of energy, again. No problem, we have our first salmonberry season, hurray! Buuuut, boy oh boy does it take ages to eat enough berries to fill that energy bar.

Well lookie there, it’s a fancy new mod by Wickedy, here to save the day and save you some time!


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/dUu9SD0.png[/img]﻿[/center]

I’ve crafted some Berry Snacks to get that energy bar filled up even faster. Take 3 salmonberries and a field snack to give you a berry bar with a lot more energy and a little boost to foraging. Still not enough? If you got your hands on a solar essence you can dry out 5 mashed berries to a tasty fruit leather, sure to give you an even bigger boost! Both come in two flavors, salmonberry and blackberry for that fall-time season. Healthy, filling, and berry berry good!

These are all known by default and are under "crafting"

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/G45JSJQ.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]

[b][size=4]Berry Bars:
[/size][/b]Three Salmonberries or Blackberries and one field snack gives you:
+1 Foraging (approx 3 min)
+15 Max Energy (approx 3 min)
+125 Energy (35 more than the total of regular quality ingredients)
+56 Health (3 more than the total of regular quality ingredients)

Salmonberry Bars ship for 65g, Blackberry Bars ship for 150g *Not affected by Bear Knowledge

[size=4][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/TwW7hsA.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
[b]
Fruit Leather:[/b][/size]
Five Salmonberries or Blackberries and one solar essence gives you:
+2 Foraging (approx 3 min)
+35 Max Energy (approx 3 min)
+188 Energy (as much energy as about 7.5 regular quality berries)
+84 Health (same as above, but with health)

Salmonberry Fruit Leather ships for 150g, Blackberry Fruit Leather ships for 250g *Not affected by Bear Knowledge


*Note: Some of the stats might be different depending on the other mods you have installed. Hopefully for the better!

[b][size=4]UPDATE:

[/size][/b]I added Leo in to the liked gifts list. I totally forgot to have him on the list at all. Sorry, Leo. I also adjusted the prices slightly, to be around 2x the value of the base quality berries, plus a little. Not really meant to be profitable, but is slightly if you don't have Bears Knowledge.

[b]BUSH BLOOM MOD "Support"
[/b]I was asked if I could make these available to those who have berry bushes with the Bush Bloom Mod. As mentioned in my permissions, I wanted this mod to be for making something out of the salmonberries that usually get not use, and I love the idea of having other bush berries supported. So, I have two more addons available, for the wonderful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14653]Wild Food Forage[/url][b] [/b]from Wildflourmods (for when the bush bloom version comes out) and also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15812]Huckleberry Season[/url] created by fwippy. Check those mods out, and you can find them in the optional files.
[center][b]﻿[/b][/center][b][center]Wild Raspberry and Wild Strawberry[/center][/b]
